description: Write one official term-deposit scraper adapter per scrapeable Batch 2 private bank in src/ingest/adapters/, register each in scripts/ingest.mjs ADAPTERS, and add an offline fixture regression test per bank in scripts/test-adapters.mjs. Adapter design MUST be informed by CI diagnose-workflow output (parent will supply a diagnostics digest listing, per bank, the real parseable URL, table count/shape, whether renderJs is needed, and any window-global / PDF path). Document any genuinely unscrapeable bank as BLOCKED block-by-block in ingest.mjs (SFB-batch style) rather than fabricating rates.
steps: Read the diagnostics digest the parent provides (also saved at .agents/tasks/task-private-batch2-remaining/diagnostics-digest.md). For each bank it states: the confirmed rate-page URL, table count + first/mid row sample, whether plain HTTP works or renderJs is required, and whether a window-global or PDF path is present.

For banks with a simple server-rendered (tenure, general%, senior%) retail table: subclass PrivateTableAdapter with generalCol/seniorCol set to the retail (below Rs 2-3 crore) GENERAL and SENIOR columns (pattern: hdfc.ts / federal.ts). Set renderJs:true only if diagnostics show plain HTTP yields 0 tables.

For banks whose page has multiple rate tables (retail vs bulk vs savings): override findPrivateRateTable to PIN the retail '< Rs.2/3 Crore' table by heading/content signature (pattern: shivalik.ts). Never map a bulk or savings column under the OFFICIAL retail FD badge.

For banks that publish GENERAL and SENIOR as two separate tables: override parseFdRd to join by tenure (pattern: capitalsfb.ts). For banks whose full ladder lives in a client-side JS global: read it via extractRateGlobals (pattern: icici.ts). For banks that publish only a PDF rate card: set pdfUrl (base handles the PDF path).

Each adapter: bankId matches the banks.ts id; source URL on the bank's own official domain; emit GENERAL + SENIOR retail FD rows (+ derived RD for >=1yr standard buckets via deriveRdFromFd); keep the >=4-distinct-FD-tenures junk guard. Add a doc comment explaining the page shape and column mapping.
Register each working adapter in scripts/ingest.mjs: add the import (const { XAdapter } = await import(resolve(root, `${A}/x.js`))) and push new XAdapter() into ADAPTERS.

For each bank that is genuinely unscrapeable (image-only rates, un-renderable widget, hard 403/bot-block, unparseable/dead PDF per diagnostics), do NOT register an adapter; add a documented BLOCKED comment block in ingest.mjs in the SFB-batch style (bank id, exact reason from diagnostics). Leave it rate-less; its profile renders with no rate rows.

Add a per-bank offline fixture regression test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs for each working adapter: import the compiled adapter from public/js/ingest/adapters/<id>.js, build a fixture reproducing the bank's REAL captured retail table shape (from diagnostics), call parseFdRd(FIXTURE, date), and assert: >= a reasonable number of FD rows, all rows quality OFFICIAL + bankId=<id> + official-domain source URL, a specific 1yr GENERAL rate, a specific SENIOR rate that would FAIL if general/senior columns were swapped, RD derived for >=1yr, and that garbage HTML -> 0 rows. Follow the federal/shivalik/capital test blocks as templates.

Rebuild (`env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build`) so compiled public/js/** reflects the new adapters, then run `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run typecheck` and `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node scripts/test-adapters.mjs`; all must pass offline.

Commit sources + regenerated public/js/** together. The orchestrator will push main, dispatch the ingest workflow, poll, read logs, and inspect the dataset.json diff to confirm which banks published OFFICIAL rates.
acceptance_criteria: Every scrapeable Batch 2 bank has an adapter in src/ingest/adapters/ registered in scripts/ingest.mjs ADAPTERS, with bankId matching its banks.ts id and an official-domain source URL.

Each working adapter emits retail (below Rs 2-3 crore) GENERAL + SENIOR FD rows with correct column tiering (never bulk, never savings under the FD badge) plus derived RD for >=1yr buckets, all quality OFFICIAL.

Each working adapter has an offline fixture regression test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs that asserts correct GENERAL vs SENIOR tiering (a test that fails if columns are swapped) and the full ladder, and that garbage HTML yields 0 rows.
Any unscrapeable bank is documented BLOCKED block-by-block in ingest.mjs with the specific reason and left rate-less (no adapter, no fabricated rates).
`env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run typecheck`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build`, and `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node scripts/test-adapters.mjs` all pass offline.
Compiled public/js/** committed with the sources.
verification: After push: dispatch ingest workflow, poll run to completion, read logs and confirm each registered bank shows 'refreshed' (OFFICIAL) or documented fallback; git fetch origin main and inspect public/data/dataset.json for each scraped bank (quality OFFICIAL, official-domain source, GENERAL+SENIOR present, rates 0-15%); confirm deploy concludes success
